title: I-adic completion of a ring
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $I\subseteq A$ an ideal. The *$I$-adic completion* of $A$ is the ring $A^\wedge=\varprojlim_nA/I^n$ (compatible sequences $(x_n)_n$ with $x_n\in A/I^n$, componentwise operations), with the ring map $A\to A^\wedge$, $a\mapsto(a\bmod I^n)_n$, making it an $A$-algebra, and the $A$-algebra map $A^\wedge\to A/I$, $(x_n)_n\mapsto x_1$. $A$ is *$I$-adically complete* if $A\to A^\wedge$ is bijective.
